articles.title: 'Want Good Ties': Germany's Big U-turn On Russia After Lavrov Blasts Top Diplomat In New York
articles.description: Germany’s Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul has called for Europe to have a seat at the table in any future Ukraine peace talks, saying decisions concerning Ukraine must involve Ukrainians. Speaking in Strasbourg, Wadephul also challenged Russia to demonstrate that it is serious about ending the war. His comments came days after a rare meeting with Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly in New York. Wadephul said he currently sees no willingness from Moscow to enter negotiations and warned that Germany and Europe will continue increasing pressure on Russia.

articles.title: UP Politics: SP Names Ram Gopal Yadav and Dhanraj Nathwani for Rajya Sabha
articles.description: The Samajwadi Party has announced Ram Gopal Yadav and Dhanraj Parimal Nathwani as its candidates for the Rajya Sabha elections from Uttar Pradesh. Both are scheduled to file their nominations in Lucknow in the presence of party chief Akhilesh Yadav. The Election Commission has scheduled elections for 10 Rajya Sabha seats in Uttar Pradesh, with polling set for October 16 if required. Ram Gopal Yadav is a senior Samajwadi Party leader and is seeking another term in the Upper House. Dhanraj Parimal Nathwani, the son of industrialist and Rajya Sabha MP Parimal Nathwani, has been chosen as the party's second candidate. The SP is also considering a third candidate, which could make the contest for the available seats more competitive. The BJP has not yet formally announced all its nominees. Current reports indicate that the BJP has the numbers to secure a substantial share of the 10 seats, while the SP has the numbers for two seats; a third SP candidate would require support beyond the party's existing strength.

articles.title: Putin’s drone upgrade: Russia combat-testing GPS-resistant ‘Geran-5 K5’ in Ukraine before winter?
articles.description: Russia is reportedly using a new version of its jet-powered Geran-5 strike drone as Moscow continues to upgrade its long-range weapons against Ukraine. The new variant, referred to by monitoring sources as the Geran-5 K5, may use an autonomous optical navigation system that allows it to follow terrain even when satellite navigation is disrupted. Reports also suggest a redesigned fuselage and higher speed. Ukraine has not yet officially confirmed the K5 designation or the reported optical system. If confirmed, could Putin’s latest drone upgrade make Russia’s attacks even harder for Ukrainian air defences to stop?
